AGRICULTURE — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #13
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any substance that conducts electricity
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. A mixture of two liquids

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Preserving Animal Products 9 2.6 Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygie? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Preserving Animal Products 9 2.6 Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygie.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Preserving Animal Products 9 2.6 Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygie.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Preserving Animal Products 9 2.6 Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygie.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Preserving Animal Products 9 2.6 Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygie.

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cleaning the Kitchen? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Cleaning the Kitchen.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cleaning the Kitchen.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cleaning the Kitchen.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cleaning the Kitchen.

4. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Movement of water only across a membrane
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Cleaning the Kit? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Cleaning the Kit.

   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Cleaning the Kit.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Poultry Rearing in a Fold? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Poultry Rearing in a Fold.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Poultry Rearing in a Fold.

   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water Harvesting and Storage.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water Harvesting and Storage.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water Harvesting and Storage.

8. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   C. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Preparation of Animal Products? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Preparation of Animal Products.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Preparation of Animal Products.

12. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 100 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 50 °C

13. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Glucose and oxygen

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cleaning the Kitchen 9 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Sewing Skills: Constructing? (1 mark)

   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cleaning the Kitchen 9 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Sewing Skills: Constructing.

15. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. watt (W)
   C. joule (J)
   D. pascal (Pa)

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Crop Pest and Disease Control? (1 mark)

17. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

18. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Removing all vegetation

19. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Producers
   B. Tertiary consumers
   C. Decomposers only
   D. Primary consumers only

20. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Soil Conservation Measures? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Soil Conservation Measures.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Soil Conservation Measures.

   D. Guess results without recording observations on Soil Conservation Measures.

21. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Preserving animal products? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Preserving animal products.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Preserving animal products.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Preserving animal products.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Preserving animal products.

22. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Paper burning to ash
